name: Citizenship by Naturalisation (Foreign Spouse of a Citizen)

qualifying_event.description: A foreign national married to a citizen of Botswana who has resided in Botswana for at least 5 years may apply for citizenship by naturalisation through the spouse track.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage certificate; spouse's Omang (national ID); proof of 5 years' residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Married to a citizen of Botswana.
Resided in Botswana for a period of at least 5 years.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of residence in Botswana while married to a Botswana citizen.

requirements.blocker_text: A Declaration of Intention (Form K) must be filed before the main application.

evidence_required.document: Form N (main application) with Form M supplement

sources.title: gov.bw (Botswana government portal), Department of Immigration and Citizenship -- Citizenship Application (Naturalization, Foreign Spouse): married to a Botswana citizen and resident 5+ years; 6-step process (Form K declaration, Form N application, Gazette public notice, interview, decision, renunciation); mandatory renunciation of foreign citizenship; ~1 year processing

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Botswana). Directly sourced to gov.bw's own spouse-naturalisation page -- modeled PUBLISHED. Unlike Jordan's marriage-citizenship route (see jo_citizenship_by_marriage.json), gov.bw's page frames this route in gender-neutral terms ('married to citizens of Botswana') with no differential treatment disclosed by wife/husband or by nationality -- no asymmetry was found in this pass, a genuine contrast worth noting given how many countries in this dataset DO gate marriage-based citizenship by the applicant's gender. dual_citizenship_allowed is FALSE per the same mandatory-renunciation step as bw_citizenship_naturalisation.json. Application is publicised via Government Gazette notice before a decision -- a public-notice step not seen in most other countries in this dataset, disclosed as a distinctive procedural feature.
